Fit gain, relaxation time, and equilibrium coefficient numerically; no discriminating probe is justified by the observed signatures.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed opposing-step signature and five varying-horizon rows directly identify the 3-parameter normalized before/after relaxation model; a batch is unnecessary.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Opposing step shifts and horizon dependence contradict a solely static mapping from u_now.
